sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: ZHA has been selected to design a new 198-hectare urban district in Baku, Azerbaijan . The project surrounds the existing Baku Expo Center events venue in a pine forest area that is planned to be preserved. The plan responds to the city's population growth over the past decade with a masterplan to organize the provision of a wide variety of residences. This is the firm's second project in Baku, after the Heydar Aliyev Center cultural venue, completed in 2013. On a different scale, the buildings in the new district appear to follow the geometric style inherited from Zaha Hadid , in a series of white buildings with rounded edges that convey an idea of fluid architecture.
